Training Course on “Molecular techniques applied for infectious disease research”
Saturday, 17 December 2016
11972 Hits
A hands on short-term training course for Medical teachers, Clinical Lab Practitioners and Research & Post Graduate students on “Immunological & molecular techniques applied for infectious disease research” will be held during February 13-18, 2017 at Department of Biochemistry & JB Tropical Disease Research Centre. The different techniques that will be covered include molecular (cloning and expression and recombinant proteins; real time PCR), analytical (SDS-PAGE; 2D-Electrophoresis; Western blotting), immunological (immuno assays, assays for immunomodulation, cellular and cytokine responses) and in vitro parasite cultures and anti-parasite drug screening assays. Further details on the course are available in the course pamphlet which can be downloaded from the website
www.mgims.ac.in
or you may send e-mail to the Course Organizer (
biochem@mgims.ac.in
/
mvrreddy@mgims.ac.in
).
Sponsored by Department of Biotechnology, Ministry of S&T, New Delhi
Course Pamphlet
Dr. MVR Reddy
Course organizer & Director-Professor & Head
Department of Biochemistry
MGIMS, Sevagram
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
